actions.create_association.description: Link two JumpCloud objects, such as adding a user to a group or giving a user group access to an application or device.

actions.create_association.props.targetT: The kind of object to link it to.
actions.create_object.description: Create a user, group or application. Devices join JumpCloud by installing the agent, so they cannot be created here.
actions.create_object.props.additionalFi: Any other JumpCloud fields for this object, as a JSON object, for example {"phoneNumbers": [{"type": "work", "number": "+1 555 0100"}]}. Fields above take precedence. See the JumpCloud API reference for the field names.
actions.create_object.props.objectType.d: The kind of JumpCloud object to work with.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Call any JumpCloud API endpoint with this connection. Use a path such as /systemusers for the v1 API or /v2/usergroups for the v2 API.
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).

actions.delete_object.props.objectType.d: The kind of JumpCloud object to work with.
actions.find_user_by_employee_id.descrip: Find the JumpCloud user with an exact employee ID, for example one sent by your HR system.
actions.find_user_by_employee_id.props.e: The exact employee ID stored on the user in JumpCloud. Matching is case-sensitive.
actions.get_object.description: Get a user, device, group or application, with its main fields and the full JumpCloud record.
actions.get_object.props.objectId.descri: Pick the object, or type to search by name. You can also map an ID from an earlier step.
actions.get_object.props.objectType.desc: The kind of JumpCloud object to work with.
actions.list_objects.description: List users, devices, groups or applications, one page at a time or all pages at once.
actions.list_objects.props.fetchAll.desc: Keep requesting pages until every object is returned, up to Max Objects.
actions.list_objects.props.limit.descrip: How many objects to return per run, from 1 to 100. Ignored when Fetch All Pages is on.

actions.list_objects_by_id.props.maxItem: Safety cap when fetching all pages, up to 10000.
actions.list_objects_by_id.props.objectT: The kind of JumpCloud object to work with.
actions.list_objects_by_id.props.skip.de: How many objects to skip before the first result. Use the Next Skip value from a previous run to get the next page.
actions.lock_user.description: Lock a user so they cannot sign in to JumpCloud, their devices or connected applications until unlocked.
actions.lock_user.props.userId.descripti: Pick the object, or type to search by name. You can also map an ID from an earlier step.
actions.reset_user_mfa.description: Clear the multi-factor authentication enrollment of a user so they set it up again, for example after losing their phone.
actions.reset_user_mfa.props.allowGraceP: Lets the user sign in without MFA until they enroll again, for the number of days below.
Allow Sign-in Without MFA for a While

actions.reset_user_mfa.props.userId.desc: Pick the object, or type to search by name. You can also map an ID from an earlier step.
actions.run_trigger_command.description: Run the JumpCloud commands launched by a trigger name, and optionally wait for their results.
actions.run_trigger_command.props.instru: In the JumpCloud Admin Portal, open **Device Management > Commands**, edit the command, set **Launch Event** to **Run on Trigger (webhook)** and enter a **Trigger Name**. Use that name below.
actions.run_trigger_command.props.trigge: The Trigger Name set on the command in JumpCloud. Every command with this name runs.
actions.run_trigger_command.props.variab: Optional JSON object passed to the command. JumpCloud exposes each key to the script as an environment variable.
actions.run_trigger_command.props.waitFo: Wait until each command reports a result, up to the time below.
actions.run_trigger_command.props.waitSe: How long to wait for results, from 5 to 300 seconds. Devices that are offline report later.
actions.search_objects.description: Find users, devices, groups or applications by text or by a field value.
actions.search_objects.props.fetchAll.de: Keep requesting pages until every object is returned, up to Max Objects.
actions.search_objects.props.filterField: A JumpCloud field name, for example department, jobTitle, email or name. Leave empty to search by text.
actions.search_objects.props.filterValue: The value to compare with. Matching is case-sensitive.
actions.search_objects.props.limit.descr: How many objects to return per run, from 1 to 100. Ignored when Fetch All Pages is on.
actions.search_objects.props.maxItems.de: Safety cap when fetching all pages, up to 10000.

Matches names, usernames, emails or hostnames. Leave empty to filter by a field instead.
actions.search_objects.props.skip.descri: How many objects to skip before the first result. Use the Next Skip value from a previous run to get the next page.
actions.unlock_user.description: Unlock a user who was locked by an admin or by too many failed sign-in attempts.
actions.unlock_user.props.userId.descrip: Pick the object, or type to search by name. You can also map an ID from an earlier step.
actions.update_object.description: Change fields on a user, device, group or application. Fields you leave empty keep their current value.

actions.update_object.props.fields.descr: Only filled-in fields are changed. Empty fields keep their current value.
actions.update_object.props.objectId.des: Pick the object, or type to search by name. You can also map an ID from an earlier step.
actions.update_object.props.objectType.d: The kind of JumpCloud object to work with.
actions.update_user_on_system.descriptio: Set a user's administrator (sudo) rights on a device, binding the user to the device first if you choose.
actions.update_user_on_system.props.bind: Binds the user to the device when they are not bound yet. Leave off to only change an existing binding.
actions.update_user_on_system.props.sudo: Gives the user administrator rights on this device.
Lets the user run administrator commands without typing their password. Only applies with administrator rights.
actions.update_user_on_system.props.syst: Pick the object, or type to search by name. You can also map an ID from an earlier step.
actions.update_user_on_system.props.user: Pick the object, or type to search by name. You can also map an ID from an earlier step.
auth.description:
Connect with a JumpCloud administrator API key.

1. Sign in to the [JumpCloud Admin Portal](https://console.jumpcloud.com).
2. Click your account initials in the top-right corner and choose **My API Key**.
3. Generate a key if you have none, copy it and paste it below.
4. Pick the region your organization lives in. Use **EU** if you sign in at console.eu.jumpcloud.com, **India** for console.in.jumpcloud.com.

The key acts with the permissions of the admin who owns it.
auth.props.apiKey.description: The administrator API key from My API Key in the Admin Portal.
auth.props.orgId.description: Only needed if you manage several organizations (multi-tenant admin). Find it in the Admin Portal under Settings > Organization Profile. Leave empty otherwise.
auth.props.region.description: The data center your JumpCloud organization lives in.
